snippet.title: Catgirl Survivor 2: Beyond the Veil | Official Reveal Trailer (Co-op Pixel Beat 'em up)
snippet.description:
[About the Game]
The girls are back, and the fight is fiercer than ever!
Minimum Studio proudly presents the official reveal trailer for Catgirl Survivor 2: Beyond the Veil.

Dive into a high-octane pixel art beat 'em up where sleek, battle-ready nekomimi heroines face off against relentless hordes. With evolved combat mechanics, devastating combos, and dynamic character designs, it’s time to team up and take back the streets.

[Key Features]
🗡️ Intense Beat 'em up Action: Master deep combo systems, unique skill sets, and crushing ultimate attacks tailored to each character.
👯‍♀️ 2-Player Co-op: Grab a friend for local or online multiplayer to synergize your attacks and take down epic bosses together.
🎨 Stunning Pixel Art: Experience gorgeous, fluidly animated sprites and vibrant, meticulously crafted stages.
🔥 Ruthless Foes: From Corrupted Druids to Undead Rockstars, battle your way through a wildly diverse cast of enemies.

Don't miss out on the action—Wishlist now on Steam and be the first to know when we launch!
[https://store.steampowered.com/app/4036210/Catgirl_Rage_Claws_of_Fury_Demo/]

[Join the Community]
🐦 Twitter / X: [https://x.com/minimumstudiogm]

#CatgirlSurvivor2 #PixelArt #IndieGame #BeatEmUp #CoopGaming #GameTrailer #Nekomimi #SteamGames
